sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2025
sources.text: Six robbers armed with knives boarded the tanker underway. They entered the engine room, took the 2/E and 3/E hostage, and tied them up. The robbers stole engine spares prior to escaping. Alarm raised and crew mustered. The incident was reported to VTIS West and Central.
